title: Demo: Vision Lab Assistant
description: A placeholder showcase entry for an image-labeling assistant that helps students organize lab experiment photos.
content:
## Demo Content

This is placeholder content for testing the Projects page layout. It is not a real student submission.

Vision Lab Assistant imagines a lightweight interface for sorting experiment photos, highlighting detected objects, and preparing labeled image sets for class projects.

![Image review board](images/image-review-board.svg)

## What This Demonstrates

- Project cards with a visual-heavy thumbnail
- Tags and metadata compatible with the existing project editor export format
- A write-up that includes a second embedded CDN image
